items.title: Deliver a deterministic backlog workflow
items.description: Prove that an agent can establish and reconcile a complete GitHub backlog.
acceptance_criteria: The lifecycle converges from bootstrap through verified synchronization.

items.title: Exercise every backlog layer
items.description: Represent initiative, epic, feature, delivery work, and implementation tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Every configured hierarchy layer is represented by a linked issue.

items.title: Reconcile a live GitHub Project
items.description: Create fields, views, iterations, issues, hierarchy, and dependencies deterministically.
acceptance_criteria: A second scaffold and sync plan both contain zero actions.

items.title: Plan a dependency-safe sprint
items.description: As a maintainer, I want deterministic sprint selection so commitments remain feasible.
acceptance_criteria: A prerequisite appears before work that depends on it.

items.title: Establish the evaluation prerequisite
items.description: Create the prerequisite needed by the dependent implementation task and bug fix.
acceptance_criteria: Dependent items identify this task through a native dependency.

items.title: Complete the dependent implementation
items.description: Exercise dependency ordering and iteration assignment on a second task.
acceptance_criteria: The task is selected only after TASK-0001.

items.title: Repair a dependency-sensitive defect
items.description: Exercise bug typing and dependency reconciliation in the live project.
acceptance_criteria: The bug preserves its type and dependency after synchronization.

items.title: Retain an unrefined idea outside the sprint
items.description: Prove that ingestion can preserve uncertainty without inventing readiness.
acceptance_criteria: The item remains in Refining and is excluded from sprint commitment.
